status: Closed — lane-session mismatch diagnostics and stale-lane adoption are implemented and re-verified on 2026-09-06
finding: Lane-id ownership mismatch renders the same actor on both sides of ATM_TASK_CLAIM_OWNER_MISMATCH, and bare follow-up commands silently mint a new lane unless the operator keeps ATM_LANE_SESSION_ID bound. This makes valid same-actor recovery look self-contradictory and token-expensive.
expectedBehavior: When ownershipMode is lane-id, the error code and prose should compare lane sessions directly, and lane adopt should persist the adopted session for subsequent commands or emit an explicit env-binding requirement that does not silently remint.
evidenceOrRepro: Original mismatch reproduced by the focused contract test, then re-verified on 2026-09-06: `node --strip-types tests/cli/claim-owner-mismatch-message.test.ts` passed with lane-specific holding/requested IDs and an adopt command; `node --strip-types tests/cli/lane-dual-session-e2e.test.ts` passed with two concurrent lanes, stale-lane adoption, lease preservation, and task rebinding. Current diagnostics use `ATM_LANE_SESSION_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH` and expose the holding lane directly.
followUp: Keep the focused mismatch and dual-session regressions in the release validation set. If a future issue concerns cross-lane handoff after a long validator, open a separate card with a fresh reproduction rather than reopening this closed finding.
